verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 111.8 (-0.2% in a day) and momentum is 34: prices are falling fast. 84s cost 700, 85s 750 and 86s 4,700. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-05T11:57:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 5,000 coins. Now 4,700. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 5,000 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 2 so far, averaging +35.0% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Ellen White 88 Base Icon after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 405,000 coins. Now 500,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 6 so far, averaging -1.7% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 750 (0.36 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,700 (1.15 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,800 (1.24 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Kai Wagner and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Kai Wagner 75 Rare -62.5%; Yacine Adli 76 Rare -45.3%; Pietro Comuzzo 75 Rare -44.1%; Timo Baumgartl 85 Star Performer -41.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
